description: This file contains functions and type definitions related to IRC group matching, access control, and message handling within an IRC extension module.

methods.name: resolveIrcGroupMatch
methods.description: Determines if a target IRC group matches allowlist rules, considering case-insensitivity and wildcards.

methods.name: resolveIrcGroupAccessGate
methods.description: Decides if access to an IRC group is allowed based on group policy and match status.

methods.name: resolveIrcRequireMention
methods.description: Determines if a mention is required for a given IRC channel configuration.

methods.name: resolveIrcMentionGate
methods.description: Decides whether to skip processing based on mention status and command authorization.

methods.name: resolveIrcGroupSenderAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a message sender is allowed based on group policy and allowlist configurations.
